title: mail: session resource endpoint (GET /jmap/session)
description:
Implement GET /jmap/session in crates/mail/src/jmap/session.rs. Returns SessionResource JSON per RFC 8620 §2: capabilities (urn:ietf:params:jmap:core, urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail), accounts (one account per authenticated user with mail capability), primaryAccounts, username, apiUrl (/jmap/api), downloadUrl, uploadUrl, eventSourceUrl, state (opaque version string). Require bearer token auth (Authorization: Bearer <token> or Basic).

Why: JMAP clients call this first to discover all API parameters; without it no client can connect.

Acceptance: integration test: authenticated GET /jmap/session returns 200 with correct capability fields.
